entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
Support. I need to make a return.
Connecting you to a VeloFit support agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return an item. I don't have a lot of time, so let's make this quick. The order number is VF881-2094.
Of course. I can certainly help with that. Let me pull up order VF881-2094... Okay, I see the purchase of the VeloPro cycling shoes. What specifically is the issue?
They're just not right. The fit is terrible, and after one ride I got blisters. The position for the cleats feels wrong for my pedal stroke. I just want a refund.
I'm very sorry to hear the cycling shoes caused blisters. That's definitely not the experience we want for you. Let me check the return eligibility.
Okay, I see you received them 61 days ago. Our policy for standard items allows for returns within 90 days, so you are well within the window. I can absolutely process this for you.
Great. So you're approving the refund?

Yes, I have. And as a valued VIP member, I've also waived the return shipping fee. I've just emailed a pre-paid return label to the address on your account. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it at any shipping center. Your refund will be processed as soon as we receive the item.
Okay, I see the email. That works. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day!
